title: Good padded clone occurrence
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with template $\Psi$ and variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement. For natural numbers $r,M$, suppose every outcome's predicate has arity at most $r$. A padded clone occurrence is good when the map sending each predicate position to its original variable paired with its assigned clone index is injective.
